column1: NUCCESS Recommendation Rules Engine  -  Extended Scenarios (v3, September 2026)

68 additional worked scenarios (4 per state cell + 3 “Not sure” + 1 immediate-safety), built to fill the coverage gaps listed in Tab 12. Same left-to-right layout as Tab 0, plus three columns on the right: the band safety modifiers applied (Tab 10), the final band with its traffic-light indicator, and the gap each row tests. Energy axis: Very Low / Low / Moderate / High. Mood axis: Very Bad / Bad / Neutral / Good. Rules: Tab 2 (families), Tab 3 (contexts), Tab 4 (TX overdue), Tab 6 (demand types), Tab 7 patterns 16-30, Tab 10 (band modifiers). v3.2: 22 further rows test the two new support pathways, Reflect and Meditate (Rituals / Prayer), including three guard rows where they must NOT be offered.

Read a row left to right: STATE (Tab 1) + EXPERIENCE (Tab 2, sensations per screen S09) + CONTEXT (screen S10 - environment, social, time/transition, available support) gives INTERVENTION SEQUENCE (Tab 2 domains filtered by Tab 3) and RECOMMENDATION (Tab 7 CTA). Every rationale follows one shape: Because <your state> and <what you're feeling>, Nuccess <what it suggests>. <what comes next>.
